# Support

- Ask installation, usage, and troubleshooting questions in [Discord](https://scalius.com/discord).
- Report reproducible bugs and product proposals with the [issue forms](https://github.com/scaliuslabs/scalius-commerce-lite/issues/new/choose). Keep each issue to one independently deliverable problem. Remove secrets, credentials, OTPs, receipt proofs, session tokens, and buyer personal data before you post.
- Report security vulnerabilities privately, as the [security policy](../SECURITY.md) describes. Never use a public issue or Discord.
